title: Find a car
searchPlaceholder: Plate number, or part of one
searchHint: Dashes, dots and spaces are ignored - type it as you see it.
includeVacated: Include bays the car has left
provenance: The plate was {{width}} px wide in the frame. Wider readings are more reliable.
shakyHint: Read with low confidence - worth looking at the car before telling anyone.
vacatedHint: This is where the car was last seen. It has since left the bay.
noMatchesHint: A plate is only recorded when a camera could read it. Cars parked tail-in, at an angle, or in poor light often park without one being read - so no match does not mean the car is not here.
